ops.title: CI lint: golangci-lint version pinned; four files await a deliberate version bump
ops.description:
Two halves. The first is landed; the second is deliberately unfiled work.

## Half 1 (DONE) — pin the version, because 'latest' is the root cause

.github/workflows/ci.yml ran golangci-lint-action@v9 with 'version: latest'. That means an upstream golangci-lint release can turn main red with ZERO code change, on a schedule nobody here controls. That is exactly how this repo spent 2026-08-17 to 2026-08-29 red, and how PR #1 (the daemonkit v0.23.0 bump) merged over a failing CI/lint check (see note 97c6106).

Pinned to v2.13.2 — the version 'latest' resolved to on 2026-08-30.

## Half 2 (NOT DONE, on purpose) — four files, to be swept WITH a chosen bump

orchestrate/adoptops.go
orchestrate/cli.go
orchestrate/render.go
orchestrate/spawn.go

These are clean under v2.13.2 and dirty under standalone gofumpt v0.10.0's newer rule, which wants a multiline call's closing bracket on its own line:

    -	return append(claudeInvocation(),
    +	return append(
    +		claudeInvocation(),

Do NOT sweep these pre-emptively. Sweeping to v0.10.0's rules today just moves the tripwire — the next version bump moves it again. Reformat them in the SAME commit that raises the pin, so the bump and the churn land together and CI is green on both sides.

## The three-way version finding — the genuinely non-obvious part

Three gofumpt versions are live in this repo and they disagree about which files are unformatted:

  - .pre-commit-config.yaml rev + local brew install: golangci-lint v2.12.2 — reports the tree CLEAN, flags nothing
  - .github/workflows/ci.yml ('version: latest' on 2026-08-30): golangci-lint v2.13.2 — flags 4 files
  - standalone gofumpt on PATH: v0.10.0 — flags 6, incl. a bracket rule CI does not enforce

Consequences, both of which cost a cycle in the v0.17.0 release lane:

  - 'golangci-lint fmt' with the LOCAL v2.12.2 is a no-op here and PROVES NOTHING. It exits 0 on a tree CI rejects. Do not treat a green local fmt as evidence.
  - Blanket 'gofumpt -w' OVER-formats — it applies v0.10.0's bracket rule to the four files above, which CI is happy without.

The reliable move is to install the version CI actually resolves and enumerate with it:

    GOBIN=/tmp/glci go install github.com/golangci/golangci-lint/v2/cmd/golangci-lint@v2.13.2
    CGO_ENABLED=0 /tmp/glci/golangci-lint fmt --diff ./...   # enumerate
    CGO_ENABLED=0 /tmp/glci/golangci-lint fmt ./...          # apply
    CGO_ENABLED=0 /tmp/glci/golangci-lint run ./...          # expect: 0 issues

## CGO_ENABLED=0 is load-bearing in two places

1. The CI lint job sets it so ptyhost/grid_cgo.go is excluded by build tag and no native libghostty-vt is needed.
2. WITHOUT it, the local prek golangci-lint hook aborts every 'ccx vcs ship' with:

       ptyhost/grid_cgo.go:9:5: could not import go.mitchellh.com/libghostty
       Package 'libghostty-vt-static' not found

   That is a local-environment artifact, not a lint failure. Run ships as 'CGO_ENABLED=0 ccx vcs ship ...'.

## Also worth knowing

golangci-lint's 'max-same-issues: 3' default caps issues sharing one message per linter. 'File is not properly formatted (gofumpt)' is ONE message, so a run reports at most 3 unformatted files however many there really are. The run on de0ceac showed 3; there were 4. Fixing the visible 3 surfaced the 4th and cost an extra red CI cycle. Always enumerate locally with the pinned version rather than trusting the CI list to be complete.

ops.text: .github/workflows/ci.yml pins golangci-lint-action to an explicit version rather than 'latest'
The next pin raise reformats orchestrate/{adoptops,cli,render,spawn}.go in the SAME commit, so CI is green on both sides of the bump
At the pinned version, CGO_ENABLED=0 golangci-lint fmt --diff ./... is empty and run ./... reports 0 issues on main
